rows.details: Government of India, NITI Aayog (Admin-IV Section)
Bachelor's degree from a recognised University with one year experience in staff welfare activities
Within 42 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News

content_sections.heading: About NITI Aayog Assistant Welfare Officer
content_sections.text: NITI Aayog, located at NITI Bhawan, New Delhi, is filling one vacant post of Assistant Welfare Officer in Level-6 (Rs. 35400-112400) of the Pay Matrix. The appointment is proposed to be filled on deputation including short-term contract basis from amongst officers of the Central Government or State Governments or Union territories or Public Sector Undertakings or Semi-Government or Autonomous or Statutory Organisations. The period of deputation (including short term contract) including period of deputation (including short-term contract) in another ex-cadre post held immediately preceding this appointment in the same or some other organisation or department of the Central Government shall ordinarily not to exceed three years.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Postal Address: Arvind Kumar, Under Secretary to the Government of India, Government of India, NITI Aayog, (Admin-IV Section), NITI Bhawan, New Delhi FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Bachelor's degree from a recognised University. One year experience in staff welfare activities. Officers of the Central Government or State Governments or Union territories or Public Sector Undertakings or Semi-Government or Autonomous or Statutory Organisations: Holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or With six years' service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on a regular basis in Level-5 (Rs. 29200 - 92300) of the pay matrix or equivalent in the parent cadre or department; or With ten years' service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on a regular basis in Level-4 (Rs. 25500 - 81100) of the pay matrix or equivalent in the parent cadre or department.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age-limit for appointment by deputation (including short term contract) shall not be exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The applications must be forwarded along with the following documents: Proof of educational qualifications and experience (self-attested); Original/attested photocopies of the APARs for the last 5 years; Vigilance clearance certificate; Integrity Certificate; No Major/Minor penalty certificate for last 10 years.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The information furnished in the Curriculum Vitae duly supported by the documents in respect of essential qualification / work experience submitted by candidates will also be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection for the post.

faq.question: Q1. What is the name of the post notified by NITI Aayog?
faq.answer: NITI Aayog has notified one vacant post of Assistant Welfare Officer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the mode of application for NITI Aayog Assistant Welfare Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be forwarded through proper channel in the enclosed pro-forma.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: Applications must reach within 42 days' from the date of publication of this advertisement in Employment News.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay scale for the Assistant Welfare Officer post?
faq.answer: The post is in Level-6 (Rs. 35400-112400) of the Pay Matrix.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for appointment?
faq.answer: The maximum age-limit for appointment by deputation (including short term contract) shall not be exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree from a recognised University and one year experience in staff welfare activities.

faq.question: Q7. What are the service requirements for candidates applying on deputation?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre or department, or have 6 years' service in Level-5, or 10 years' service in Level-4 in the parent cadre or department.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents must be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Applications must be forwarded along with proof of educational qualifications and experience (self-attested), original/attested photocopies of the APARs for the last 5 years, vigilance clearance certificate, integrity certificate, and no major/minor penalty certificate for last 10 years.
